name: Influence Labs IA — Studio Tirra Webchat

terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: Express webchat API (studio-tirra-webchat-backend). Serves GET /health and POST /webhook/demo-chat on port 3001. TESS_API_TOKEN and TRINKS_API_KEY are optional secrets; without them the API runs and degrades gracefully.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Static server for the WhatsApp-style demo chat UI. Open http://localhost:8080/demo-chat.html — it auto-targets the local backend at http://localhost:3001/webhook/demo-chat.
